description: This file defines the class 'dm_device_list_t', which manages a list of devices and their orchestration within a mesh network. It includes method declarations for initialization, database synchronization, device management, and configuration, serving as an interface and base class for device list implementations.

classes.name: dm_device_list_t
classes.description: A class representing a list of devices in a mesh network, providing interface methods for device management, database synchronization, and configuration.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialize the device list by setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Retrieve the orchestration type for a specific device using a database client.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Update the device list by adding or removing devices.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Delete and clean up all devices from the list.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Set up the table structure for managing devices.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initialize display or data columns for the device list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronize the database state with the device list.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Perform updates on the database with specified operation types.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Search the database for a specific device.

methods.name: compare_db
methods.description: Compare a device against database records.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Configure the database client or device using JSON input.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieve configuration details from JSON data.

methods.name: get_first_device
methods.description: Get the first device in the device list (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_next_device
methods.description: Get the next device after the given device (pure virtual).

methods.name: get_device
methods.description: Find a device by key (pure virtual).

methods.name: remove_device
methods.description: Remove a device by key (pure virtual).

methods.name: put_device
methods.description: Add a device with a key (pure virtual).
